faqs.q: Can I choose what jewellery I get?
faqs.a: That's the magic of Jaraa — it's a mystery! You choose your budget, we choose the pieces. Every jar is a surprise curated with love.

faqs.q: What kind of jewellery is in the jars?
faqs.a: Rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, anklets, and more! We include a mix of trending styles — from dainty everyday pieces to statement jewellery.

faqs.q: Is the jewellery real / good quality?
faqs.a: Absolutely. All our jewellery is carefully sourced — hypoallergenic, tarnish-resistant, and fashion-forward. We only jar what we love ourselves.

faqs.q: Can I gift a Jaraa jar to someone?
faqs.a: Yes! Jaraa jars make the most magical gifts. You can add a personalised message at checkout and we'll include it in the packaging.

faqs.q: What if I don't like a piece?
faqs.a: We want you to love every piece! If something isn't right, reach out to us within 7 days and we'll make it right.
